title: Pronouns — Relative and Demonstrative
subtitle: That, which, who — relative pronouns emerge.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: That, which, who (but 'who' still rare as a relative pronoun in Chaucer; 'that' is more common). This, that, thise, tho (those). The demonstrative system is simpler than Old English (no seventeen-form article). The relative pronoun system is still forming.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand Pronouns — Relative and Demonstrative.
